summary: Core frontend integrations for the new hero, services (panel wiring + LED light), emergency animation, and reduced-motion handling are present via the new ReducedMotionMedia component and updated Hero/Services/ElectricianWorkAnimations components. However, the diff summary does not provide evidence that the required new generated GIF assets were actually added under frontend/public/assets/generated, and the trust/quality animation integration (REQ-10) is not verifiable from the truncated About.tsx diff.
